text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! It's truly an honor to 
celebrate with you, Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
! Ahaha, getting celebrated with so much 
enthusiasm makes me feel a bit shy~

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's not just words. I've prepared a 
special menu for today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Carrots slathered in garlic miso sauce, 
carrot Salisbury steak with carrot sauce, 
and banana mousse cake for dessert!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Isn't that Mom's special menu!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How did you know, Buena-san!? My 
ab-so-lute favorite home-cooked dish!!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Actually, I asked Spe-san's mother 
and made the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It may not match the taste from our 
memories— but my celebratory feelings are 
just as strong.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san...! I'm wicked happy~~! Even 
when my mama taught me, I could never get 
it right on my own!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm happy too. To make someone I 
admire so pleased!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Wah~, it's been so long since I tasted 
Mom's cooking—\nAh, I need to call Mom to 
thank her!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to eat it soon, and I want 
to tell Buena-san how good it is too— what 
in the world should I do~~?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Your mother comes first. I'll be waiting 
patiently for your 'It's delicious,' 
Spe-san♪
